comment: Android Play Store Data Safety section declaration. It has to match what the build actually sends: apple_privacy.json, constants/legal.ts and the hosted policy at bugrout.app/privacy all describe the same list (#206). PostHog is deliberately absent — no eas.json profile sets EXPO_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, so no shipped build initialises it.

data_shared.purpose: App functionality (turning a typed destination into coordinates)
data_shared.recipient: Nominatim, operated by the OpenStreetMap Foundation
data_shared.deletion_available: Retained per the OpenStreetMap Foundation's own policy; BugRout never receives or stores the query

data_shared.purpose: App functionality (weather alerts, water sources, fuel stations, shelters)
data_shared.recipient: National Weather Service, OpenStreetMap Overpass API, FEMA ESF6-SS, USGS and NREL
data_shared.deletion_available: Retained per each service's own policy. What is sent is the centre point or bounding box of a region you chose to download, not your live position.

data_collected.user_consent: Required for routing — the trip's start point and destination are sent to BugRout's routing service
data_collected.deletion_available: Not stored: the routing service answers the request and keeps no route history

data_collected.user_consent: User must opt in via Settings > Crowd Signal
data_collected.deletion_available: Data auto-deletes after 48 hours. Token rotates every 24 hours.
data_collected.note: Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimal places (~11 m), which both stores count as precise rather than approximate.

data_collected.purpose: App functionality (threat and resource data for a downloaded region)
data_collected.user_consent: Derived from a map region you chose to download, not from your live position
Sent only after the first-launch disclaimer is accepted, only while online, and only after you pause typing

data_collected.purpose: App functionality (grouping crowd signals from one device)
data_collected.user_consent: User must opt in via Settings > Crowd Signal
data_collected.deletion_available: Token rotates every 24 hours and can be force-rotated in Settings

data_collected.user_consent: User must opt in via Settings > Crash Reports, which is off by default
data_collected.deletion_available: Retained per Sentry data retention policy (90 days)
